_comment: Awin feeds used by Car Gear World. advertiserId is the Awin advertiser id (file names AWIN_<advertiserId>_<feedId>.csv.gz in the Awin archive). feedIds: only the retailer's current full feed (the archive also keeps older per-category feeds of Tooled Up). Without feedIds, every file of that retailer is read. Add a retailer only after Awin has approved the programme. retailer is the name shown on the site; VEVOR has the NL flag (site.config.js retailerCountries). GS Workwear sends a Google Shopping file saved in Downloads as 48473-*.csv.gz (format google, file = name pattern). Ottocast (Awin 96499, ottocast.com, approved 14 Nov 2026): 26 wireless CarPlay / Android Auto adapters and car TV boxes in two feeds; its shipping page lists only European countries (no UK), so deliversTo is that list (massive import round 2b, 14 Nov 2026, lessons L62, L107).
